# Diligent Scholars

> A production-grade, full-stack real-time social application architecture built with Express 5, React 19, and Tailwind CSS 4.

## Core Pages & Endpoints

- [Home](https://diligent-scholars.onrender.com/): User dashboard displaying friends and recommended scholars.
- [Log In](https://diligent-scholars.onrender.com/login): User authentication and session retrieval.
- [Sign Up](https://diligent-scholars.onrender.com/signup): Account registration with input validation.
- [Onboarding](https://diligent-scholars.onrender.com/onboarding): User profile setup, subject selection, and avatar configuration.
- [Notifications](https://diligent-scholars.onrender.com/notifications): Incoming friend requests and friendship status updates.

## Architecture

- **Backend**: Express 5.2.1, MongoDB with Mongoose, Pino logging, Zod validation, Helmet security.
- **Frontend**: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, DaisyUI, TanStack Query v5, Zustand state management.
- **Real-Time Communication**: Stream Chat and Stream Video SDK for messaging and WebRTC calls.
